title: BLOCKING B2: PR#24 fixes one of TWO P0 causes and reads as though closed
evidence: PR-JUDGEMENT-REVIEW.html finding B2, build_v3/validate.py:41-44. PR#24 is FIX-FIRST on this item alone.

spec.description: PR#24 fixes the path-resolution cause of the non-reproducibility P0 while its handoff reads as though the P0 is closed. It builds and VALIDATES a graph missing the four shipped tables (1,287,159 rows). The two clean builds match each other because BOTH ARE EQUALLY INCOMPLETE - matching digests prove determinism, not correctness.
spec.context: This is the same failure shape as the person_content digest exclusion, one level up: a check that passes because the thing it should have caught was excluded from what it compares. Pairs with TASK-0009 (four shipped tables absent from the tracked schema) - the two causes are independent and fixing either alone leaves the graph unreproducible. The reviewer notes this may be fixable by DOCUMENTATION ALONE if the handoff stops claiming the P0 is closed and states which cause remains. Cold independent review 2026-08-07, reviewer did not author either PR, read-only. PR#23 @ 3d648aa5c7f40551fa9137fd385ca81de0a15fd5 (re-fetched mid-review), PR#24 @ e3df51d4374cd79295e7af3c1529499bb2a52550. Both verdicts FIX-FIRST, neither RETHINK.
